purpose: Curated technical knowledge for the RGX chatbot. Commercial data must never be sourced from this file.

authority.technical: Official Trelleborg catalogs listed per family

rules: Use only facts explicitly present in this file.
Never infer a family characteristic from a variant or compound.
Never use this file as authority for price, stock, SKU or product URL.
Conditional claims must preserve their stated comparison context.
Do not use flattened PDF tables as authority for numeric load capacities, dimensions or inflation pressures.
If the requested technical fact is not present, state that it is not confirmed instead of inventing it.

guardrails.rule: The phrase radial sipes describes tread geometry. It does not mean PS1000 is a radial tire.
Anti-static properties may be described as reducing the risk of sparks in potentially explosive atmospheres.

facts.statement: XP800 is designed for medium intensity applications.
XP800 tread design is intended to support both indoor and outdoor performance.
Its wide central contact area with zig-zag profile is designed to minimize vibration and improve handling indoors.
Deep lateral lugs are designed to provide traction in outdoor applications.
Extra-deep tread is designed to increase longevity and service life.
Extra-wide tread width is designed to improve stability.
A protruding rim protector is designed to minimize wheel damage.
Multipurpose is the standard black compound intended for balanced overall performance.
Non Marking is a specialized compound designed to keep floors clean from tire marks.
The catalog reports potential cost-of-ownership savings of up to 11 percent versus compared competitors in a medium-intensity scenario.
facts.condition: Present only as a catalog comparison in its tested scenario, never as guaranteed customer savings.

facts.statement: XP1000 is specifically designed for maximum intensity applications.
The catalog identifies warehouse operations, port yards, shop floors and material-handling ground service as XP1000 applications.
The central contact area and circumferential rib profile are designed to reduce vibration and improve indoor handling.
Very deep lugs are designed to provide traction in outdoor applications.
The extra-deep tread profile is designed to maximize service life.
A protruding rim protector is designed to minimize wheel damage.
The middle cushion layer is designed to control internal temperature, absorb road roughness and reduce vibration for operator comfort.
ProHD is a specialized compound for heavy-duty applications.
ProEnergy is a cool-running compound intended for long-distance operations at consistently high speeds.
Heatshield is a flame-retardant compound designed to withstand high ambient temperatures.
Non Marking is a premium white compound designed to keep floors free from tire marks.
Electrically Conducting is a specialized black compound intended to enhance safety in flammable and explosive environments.
The catalog reports 21 percent higher temperature resistance and 13 percent higher comfort versus the compared premium competitors.
facts.condition: Present only as a manufacturer catalog comparison and never as a universal performance guarantee.

facts.statement: PS800 is designed for medium intensity applications.
PS800 is intended for everyday work in both indoor and outdoor conditions.
PS800 is available in smooth and traction versions.
The smooth version is intended to provide high performance in indoor applications.
The traction version is intended to provide grip in outdoor applications.
Its wide and flat contact profile is designed to improve stability during load handling.
Deep tread blocks are designed to increase traction outdoors.
Deep durable tread is designed to increase tire life.
Multipurpose is a standard black compound intended for balanced overall performance.
Non Marking is a specialized compound designed to keep floors clean from tire marks.
The traction version is designed to provide grip outdoors on wet pavement.
The catalog reports longer service life than compared competitors in medium-intensity applications.
facts.condition: Present only as a catalog comparison, not as a guaranteed service-life result.

facts.statement: PS1000 is a press-on solid tire.
PS1000 is positioned for maximum intensity applications.
PS1000 is offered in smooth and traction configurations.
Its design uses a concave sidewall, deep wearable tread, wide contact area and cushion construction to support stability, comfort, wear resistance and heat control.
The traction version uses deep lugs with radial sipes to improve traction in wet conditions.
PS1000 integrates the Trelleborg Pit Stop Line to indicate tire replacement timing.
The Pit Stop Line orange strip appears approximately 100 operating hours before tire replacement is needed.
Multipurpose is a premium two-stage compound with wear and rolling-resistance characteristics.
Non Marking is a premium white compound designed to keep floors clean from tire marks.
ProTEX is a non-marking compound with electrically conducting properties.
Electrically Conducting is a specialized black compound intended to enhance safety in flammable and explosive environments.
ProHD is a specialized compound for heavy-duty applications.
T-900 is designed for demanding applications.
Its block tread design and large footprint are designed to lower specific pressure and maximize tire life.
Its shock-absorbing structure, reinforced sidewalls and rim guards are designed to protect against impact damage.
Its anti-slip bead wire system is designed to improve stability.
The catalog describes greater stability for faster load positioning and improved cornering.
The tire is designed to maintain a low internal temperature during operation.
TR-900 is a radial pneumatic tire.
TR-900 is positioned for maximum intensity applications.
Its radial technology is intended for high-speed and long-distance applications.
Its block tread design and large footprint are designed to lower stress and maximize tire life.
Its reinforced sidewall is designed to reduce impact damage.
Low rolling resistance is used to improve energy efficiency.
Wear-resistant technology is intended to extend tire life and reduce downtime.
The tire is designed to absorb shocks from obstacles.
The design includes rim protection and anti-slip bead wires.
Enhanced stability is intended to support faster load positioning and cornering.
Its anti-static characteristic is intended to reduce the risk of sparks in potentially explosive atmospheres.
